skill_name: What are the different methods of communication?
workflow: The different methods of communication includes verbal communication, non-verbal communication, written communication, pictorial communication, electronic communication and body language. Verbal communication involves talking and listening, while non-verbal communication involves facial expressions, gestures and body language.
